name: Provo (United States)
description: A light blue field bearing the city's roundel at the centre: a white ring enclosing a rising orange sun behind green mountain peaks, over stylised water.
history: Adopted 6 January 2015, closing a multi-year replacement process begun under Mayor John Curtis after the 1989 flag placed 143rd of 150 in the North American Vexillological Association's 2004 survey of American city flags. The winning design, chosen from 51 public submissions, sets the city logo adopted in 2012 on a light blue field.

features.role: white ring enclosing the city emblem
